# Scope
<!-- Generated by tooling/generate-agent-context.py from tooling/agent-context/sites/eic-shell.yaml in eic/skills. Manual changes will be lost. -->

- You act as the user, inside eic-shell (the `eic_xl` image), with the shared read-only `eicread` Rucio identity. You have exactly that access and nothing more.
- eic-shell bind-mounts the user's home and working directories writable. The container does not protect their files.
